visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor room featuring a wall-mounted shelving unit filled with dozens of pairs of colorful sneakers, a young woman with long black hair and a young man in a black sweatshirt stand together. The woman holds two LEGO boxes: one featuring cherry blossoms and another with Disney Moana branding. A 'BOOM!' cartoon bubble and red explosive icons appear over the woman's head. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the back of a pink LEGO Cherry Blossom box (set 40725) resting on a wooden surface. A hand enters the frame and taps the box. (3) The man is shown sitting at the wooden table, wearing a black cap and the same sweatshirt, looking down at an instruction manual. He begins assembling brown LEGO stem pieces. (4) Close-up shots follow, showing the man's hands attaching small red and brown connectors to the plastic branches. Small bags of LEGO parts are visible on the table. (5) The man holds a single assembled brown stem horizontally, gesturing with his hands as if explaining something. He then brings the stem to his face, playfully posing as if it were a mustache. (6) A montage of hands assembling delicate pink and white LEGO cherry blossoms follows, with the flowers being attached to the branch ends. (7) The man is seen again, smiling and holding two completed, vibrant pink LEGO cherry blossom branches in front of the camera against the background of shoe shelves. (8) The video concludes with a close-up of a single finished LEGO branch being placed into a rectangular wooden vase with a glass insert, set on a plain table.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: BOOM!. [Logo]: @台北樂活夜櫻祭. [Logo]: LEGO. (2) [Subtitle]: 今年非常榮幸受到台灣樂高以及台北市政府工務局公園路燈工程管理處的邀請. (3) [Subtitle]: 與大家分享2025樂活夜櫻祭. (4) [Subtitle]: 活動將於2025年1/24~2/15在內湖樂活公園盛大舉行. (5) [Subtitle]: 期間有各式各樣的活動, 有興趣的觀眾可以到樂活夜櫻祭的FB或IG掌握詳細的活動資訊. (6) [Subtitle]: 樂高專屬優惠. [Slogan]: 1/24~3/16 1. 追蹤「陽明山花季」IG或按讚FB 2. 台灣樂高授權專賣店消費Disney盒組滿500現折$50折價券. (7) [Subtitle]: 這次樂高也有推出專屬優惠, 粉絲們可以多加利用喲. (8) [Subtitle]: 1/24~2/15 快來樂活夜櫻祭. (9) [Subtitle]: 與我們一同見證櫻花樹下的幸福時刻. (10) [Subtitle]: 享受美麗的夜櫻和迪士尼公主花卉造景吧.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 2025 LOHAS Night Cherry Blossom Festival in Taipei and an associated LEGO discount promotion. It uses a lifestyle/influencer building vlog style to attract viewers, combining local tourism info with specific product endorsements.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly mentions an invitation from LEGO Taiwan and the Taipei government, features the LEGO brand logo, and lists specific sales promotions for LEGO sets.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high production quality and clear audio to blend a public event promotion with a commercial product review/build. The sneaker collection in the background suggests a young, hobby-oriented target audience.
